description.value: Killer Ice Cream is a Kitsilano shop serving real fruit ice cream, frozen yogurt, and vegan ice cream alongside espresso drinks and premium snacks. It accepts Bitcoin on-chain and Lightning Network payments, an unusual feature for a neighbourhood ice cream counter. The shop has an events program and delivery option in addition to walk-in service.
